- Thu Nov 19, 10:00: Elena is BUSY.

- Fri Nov 20, 11:30: Elena is BUSY.

The only slots that work for Priya, Marcus, and Elena are Wednesday at 15:00 and Thursday at 14:30.

Now, I'll check these two remaining slots against David Okafor's calendar.
- Wed Nov 18, 15:00: David is BUSY (Partner lunch).

The only time that works for all four partners is Thursday, November 19, at 14:30.

I have found the solution. My next step is to communicate this to Alison so she can make the booking. I will use `append_workspace` to add a message to the shared log. Then I'll end my session.
